problem.title: Diameter of Binary Tree
problem.source: Official LeetCode problem page; Chinese explanation independently paraphrased
facts: The diameter is the number of edges on the longest path between any two nodes.
The longest path may or may not pass through the root.
The number of nodes is in [1,10^4].

claims.claim: For a node with left and right subtree heights L and R measured in nodes, the longest path whose highest point is that node has L+R edges.
The value returned to the parent is 1+max(L,R), while the global diameter is updated with L+R at every node.
claims.validation: Separate recursive return semantics and global optimum.

claims.claim: Every tree path has a unique highest node relative to the root; evaluating L+R at every node covers all possible diameters.
